title: Intraday markets, wind integration and uplift in a regional U.S. power system
California's cap-and-trade program and emission leakage in the Western Interconnection: comparing econometric and partial equilibrium model estimates
abstract: We compare the effects of California’s AB 32 cap-and-trade program on leakage in the electricity sector using two methods: a simulation-based partial equilibrium model that accounts for details of policy implementation and is parameterized using market data and an econometric model applying a quasi-experimental design with matching and a robust inference method that does not require parallel trends to hold exactly. Based on the estimated shifts in electricity generation, we infer CO2 emission leakage predictions in 2013 and 2016. The comparison allows us to identify critical assumptions driving the simulation results and to benchmark the empirical results in a complex policy setting where threats to identification undermine attempts at statistical inference. Over the study period, we find significant leakage potential ex ante and empirical evidence that is consistent with some resource shuffling ex post. Limiting the ability of electricity importers to claim the default emission factor may reduce leakage risks.
abstract_zh: 我们使用两种方法比较了加州AB 32总量控制与交易计划对电力部门碳泄漏的影响：一是基于模拟的局部均衡模型，该模型考虑了政策实施的细节，并利用市场数据进行参数化；二是计量经济模型，采用准实验设计，结合匹配方法和一种稳健的推断方法，该方法无需严格满足平行趋势假设。基于所估计的发电量变化，我们推断出2013年和2016年的CO2排放泄漏预测值。这一比较使我们能够识别驱动模拟结果的关键假设，并在一个复杂的政策环境中对实证结果进行基准检验，而在该环境中，识别威胁使统计推断难以开展。在研究期间，我们发现了显著的事前泄漏潜力，并且有证据表明，事后存在与某种资源转移相一致的经验证据。限制电力进口商申报默认排放因子的能力，可能会降低泄漏风险。

title: Leader-follower equilibria to examine investment decisions in grid resilience-enhancing measures
Cross-product manipulation in electricity markets, microstructure models and asymmetric information
abstract: Electricity market manipulation enforcement actions have moved from conventional analysis of generator market power in real-time physical markets to material allegations of sustained cross-product price manipulation in forward financial markets. A major challenge is to develop and apply forward market analytical frameworks and models. This task is more difficult than for the real-time market. An adaptation of cross-product manipulation models from cash-settled financial markets provides an existence demonstration under uncertainty and asymmetric information. The implications of this analysis include strong empirical predictions about necessary randomized strategies that are not likely to be observed or sustainable in electricity markets. Absent these randomized strategies and other market imperfections, the means for achieving sustained forward market price manipulation remains unexplained.
abstract_zh: 电力市场操纵的执法行动已从传统上对实时实物市场中发电商市场势力的分析，转向对远期金融市场中持续性跨产品价格操纵的实质性指控。一项主要挑战在于发展并应用远期市场的分析框架和模型。这项任务比实时市场更为困难。将现金结算金融市场中的跨产品操纵模型加以改造，可在不确定性和信息不对称条件下证明其存在性。该分析的含义包括强有力的经验预测，即必须存在随机化策略，而这些策略在电力市场中不太可能被观察到，也难以持续。若不存在这些随机化策略及其他市场缺陷，远期市场中持续价格操纵的实现手段仍无法得到解释。

title: Cross-product manipulation with intertemporal constraints: an equilibrium model
Virtual bidding and financial transmission rights: an equilibrium model for cross-product manipulation in electricity markets
abstract: Virtual transactions are financial positions that allow market participants to exploit arbitrage opportunities arising when day-ahead electricity prices are predictably higher or lower than expected real-time prices. Unprofitable virtual transactions may be used to move day-ahead prices in a direction that enhances the value of related positions, like financial transmission rights (FTRs). This constitutes cross-product manipulation, and has emerged as a policy concern of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission in recent years. Absent control over real-time prices, what economic conditions enable a financial market participant to manipulate day-ahead electricity prices? We develop a three-stage equilibrium model to study cross-product manipulation in FTR and two-settlement energy markets, and evaluate its effects on price convergence and other market outcomes using numerical simulations. Our model accounts for demand uncertainty, the likelihood of congestion in both day-ahead and real-time, and transmission capacity constraints at all stages in the game. Numerical results in a two-node setting show that day-ahead price manipulation through virtual transactions to profit from FTR positions is sustained only when generators and traders compete in a Cournot game in the day-ahead market. In contrast, this type of manipulation fails when the FTR holder is the only market participant acting strategically, and generation capacity and credit requirement constraints for other parties are not binding. In the Appendix, we derive conditions for the existence of the day-ahead equilibria and the single-leader multi-follower equilibrium of the three-stage game.
abstract_zh: 虚拟交易是一种金融头寸，当日前电价可预见地高于或低于预期的实时电价时，市场参与者可借此套利。亏损的虚拟交易可能被用来推动日前价格朝有利于相关头寸（如金融输电权，Financial Transmission Rights，FTR）的方向变动。这构成了跨产品操纵，并且近年来已成为美国联邦能源监管委员会（FERC）关注的政策问题。在无法控制实时价格的情况下，何种经济条件使金融市场参与者能够操纵日前电价？我们构建了一个三阶段均衡模型，用以研究FTR市场与两结算能源市场中的跨产品操纵，并利用数值模拟评估其对价格趋同及其他市场结果的影响。我们的模型考虑了需求不确定性、日前和实时阶段发生阻塞的可能性，以及博弈各阶段的输电容量约束。在双节点设定下的数值结果表明，只有当发电商和交易商在日前市场中进行古诺（Cournot）竞争时，通过虚拟交易操纵日前价格以获取FTR头寸收益的做法才能持续。相反，当FTR持有者是唯一进行策略性行为的市场参与者，且其他参与方的发电容量和信用额度约束不具约束力时，这种操纵便会失效。在附录中，我们推导了日前均衡以及三阶段博弈中单领导者多跟随者均衡存在的条件。

title: Weather or not? Welfare impacts of natural gas pipeline expansion in the Northeastern U.S.
abstract:
New production of natural gas in the Marcellus region of Pennsylvania has created tremendous opportunities to increase natural gas use in the U. S. Unfortunately, the benefits from this new production are limited by the scarcity of pipeline capacity out of the region. Several new pipelines have been proposed to address this issue. Here we focus on the potential economic effects of one of these projects, the proposal by the Williams Company to expand its Transcontinental Gas (“Transco”) pipeline through the Atlantic Sunrise project in the northeastern United States. The Atlantic Sunrise project would permit additional deliveries from the Marcellus region to markets on the main Transco system. It would also afford more flexibility to the Transco system, by creating the ability to accommodate flow reversals in response to market conditions.
To understand the market impact of the Atlantic Sunrise expansion, we develop a model, based on the arbitrage cost approach in Kleit (2001), that is well suited for fine-grained spatial evaluation of the market effects of relieving gas transmission constraints, employing daily data from 2012 to the middle of 2014. To our knowledge, this is the first paper to address the question of the economic effects of a natural gas pipeline expansion.
Over the 30-month period examined in our study we estimate that consumers served by Transco from Alabama to New Jersey would have enjoyed about $2.6 billion in total benefits because of the Atlantic Sunrise expansion. There are two specific aspects of our findings, however, we wish to emphasize. First, the benefits to consumers are not uniform over time and will vary greatly with system conditions. More than 60 percent of the benefits in our period of study would have accrued in January 2014 alone, because of the high level of gas demand associated with the “polar vortex” in that month.
Second, the benefits to consumers are not uniform over geographic areas. Because of the location of the constraints on the Transco system, we estimate that Virginia-North Carolina-South Carolina customers would benefit nearly three times as much as Alabama-Georgia customers.
Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland customers exhibit the highest benefits overall, but would have also been harmed during certain periods when exports from this region to Virginia cause prices north of Virginia to increase. These price increases, however, are far smaller than the price decreases that would occur due to Atlantic Sunrise during severe winter periods.
abstract_zh:
宾夕法尼亚州马塞勒斯（Marcellus）地区新增的天然气产量为美国扩大天然气使用创造了巨大机遇。遗憾的是，这一新增产量的效益受到该地区外输管道容量稀缺的限制。已有若干新管道项目被提出以解决这一问题。本文聚焦于其中一个项目——威廉姆斯公司（Williams Company）提出的通过大西洋日出（Atlantic Sunrise）项目扩建其跨大陆天然气（“Transco”）管道的方案——的潜在经济影响。大西洋日出项目将允许马塞勒斯地区向Transco系统主干市场增加供气，同时通过使系统能够应对市场条件变化而实现逆向流动，从而提高Transco系统的灵活性。
为理解大西洋日出扩建的市场影响，我们基于Kleit（2001）的套利成本方法构建了一个模型，该模型非常适用于对缓解天然气输送约束的市场效应进行细粒度的空间评估，并使用了2012年至2014年年中的日度数据。据我们所知，这是第一篇探讨天然气管道扩建经济效应的论文。
在我们研究的30个月期间，我们估计，由于大西洋日出扩建，从亚拉巴马州到新泽西州、由Transco供气的消费者本可获得约26亿美元的总收益。不过，我们希望强调我们研究发现的两个具体方面。第一，消费者的收益在时间上并不均匀，并将随系统状况发生极大变化。在我们的研究期间，超过60%的收益将仅在2014年1月产生，原因是当月因“极地涡旋”而出现的高天然气需求。
第二，消费者的收益在地理区域上也不均匀。由于Transco系统约束的位置，我们估计，弗吉尼亚州至北卡罗来纳州、南卡罗来纳州一带的客户所获收益将接近亚拉巴马州至佐治亚州客户的三倍。
宾夕法尼亚州-新泽西州-马里兰州的客户总体上收益最高，但在某些时期也会受损：该地区向弗吉尼亚州的出口会导致弗吉尼亚以北地区的价格上涨。然而，这些价格上涨远小于大西洋日出项目在严冬时期可能引起的价格下跌。

title: A cooperative game theoretic analysis of incentives for microgrids in regulated electricity markets
Market power in power markets: an analysis of residual demand curves in California's day-ahead energy market in 1998-2000
abstract: 2000, with a focus on its day-ahead energy market and its five non-utility thermal generating companies. Our goal is to assess whether the hourly bids of market participants, together with information on thermal unit characteristics and power output, suggest that the five suppliers were behaving in line with Nash supply function competition, bidding close to their marginal costs or restraining quantities relative to the Nash level. The analysis of residual demand inverse elasticities suggests that the five thermal generators had an incentive to exercise unilateral market power that was not always fully exploited. A comparison of market-clearing prices, estimated marginal costs and marginal revenues finds that firm conduct was broadly consistent with Nash supply function competition or more competitive than Nash behavior in most of our sample.
abstract_zh: 2000年，本文聚焦于加州的日前能源市场及其五家非公用事业火电发电企业。我们的目标是评估市场参与者的逐小时报价，连同火电机组特征和发电出力信息，是否表明这五家供应商的行为符合纳什供给函数竞争（Nash supply function competition），即报价接近其边际成本，或相对于纳什水平限制供应量。对剩余需求逆弹性的分析表明，这五家火电发电商有动机行使单边市场势力，但这种势力并未总被充分利用。对市场出清价格、估计的边际成本和边际收益的比较发现，在我们的大部分样本中，企业行为总体上与纳什供给函数竞争相一致，或比纳什行为更具竞争性。

title: Upper level of a sustainability assessment framework for power system planning
abstract: This paper describes the upper level of a two-tiered sustainability assessment framework (SAF) for determining the optimal synthesis/design and operation of a power network and its associated energy production and storage technologies. The upper-level framework is described, and results for its application to a test bed scenario given by the Northwest European electricity power network presented. A brief description of the lower level of the SAF is given as well. In order to analyze the impact of microgrids (MGs) in the main network, two different scenarios are considered in the analysis, i.e., a network without MGs and a network with MGs. The optimization is carried out in a multi-objective, quasi-stationary manner with producer partial-load behavior taken into account via nonlinear functions for efficiency, cost, and emissions that depend on the electricity generated by each nonrenewable or renewable producer technology. Results indicate for the particular problem posed and for the optimal configurations found that including MGs improves the network relative to reductions in capital and operating costs and to increases in network resiliency. On the other hand, total daily SO2 emissions and network exergetic efficiency are not improved for the case when MGs are included.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了一个两层可持续性评估框架（Sustainability Assessment Framework，SAF）的上层，该框架用于确定电网及其相关能源生产和储存技术的最优综合设计与运行。文中描述了上层框架，并给出了其在以西北欧电网为测试场景的应用结果。文中还简要说明了SAF的下层。为分析微电网（MG）对主电网的影响，本文考虑了两种情景，即不含微电网的电网和含微电网的电网。优化问题以多目标、准稳态的方式求解，并通过非线性函数考虑了发电商的部分负荷行为，这些函数描述了每种不可再生或可再生发电技术的效率、成本和排放如何依赖于其发电量。对于本文所设定的特定问题及所得到的最优配置，结果表明，纳入微电网可在降低资本和运营成本以及提高电网韧性方面改善电网状况。另一方面，当纳入微电网时，每日二氧化硫总排放量和电网的火用效率并未得到改善。
